paras_en: Demand for advanced chips from U.S. chip giant NVIDIA (NVDA-US) continues to rise among Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) firms, but global capacity constraints mean actual deliveries are likely far below expectations. While demand is surging, NVIDIA is working to expand capacity but still struggles to meet market needs.

According to Bloomberg, insiders say Alibaba (09988-HK), Tencent Holdings (00700-HK), ByteDance and other Chinese AI and cloud service providers have collectively ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips.
However, these companies estimate that over the next four months they will receive only tens of thousands of units, roughly 1% of the total order volume.

Insiders note that each RTX Pro 5500 sells for more than $11,000, bringing the cumulative order value to about $70 billion. The strong demand from China’s large‑scale cloud providers (hyperscalers) highlights a severe shortage of domestic AI compute capacity and shows that even as local hardware makers make technical progress, they remain limited in capability. The chip shortage will make it even harder for Chinese AI firms to catch up with leading U.S. companies.

Although the United States bans NVIDIA from selling its most advanced AI chips to China, the RTX Pro 5500 does not yet fall under those export controls, so it can still be purchased for the Chinese market.

Nevertheless, with domestic suppliers Huawei and Alibaba’s Pingtouge still lagging behind U.S. competitors in technology and manufacturing, the RTX Pro 5500 has become one of the few high‑end AI chips available in China.

NVIDIA prioritizes capacity for its high‑end products while Chinese orders wait in line. NVIDIA has spent years lobbying the U.S. government to relax chip‑sale restrictions to China, but global manufacturing shortfalls also make it difficult to satisfy Chinese buyers.
Global AI‑chip demand continues to explode, and NVIDIA is allocating its limited capacity first to more advanced, higher‑margin products, mainly serving customers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

Insiders say China’s major AI firms expect to receive the first few thousand RTX Pro 5500 units by the end of this year, with another shipment of tens of thousands around February next year – the only two batches currently confirmed for delivery.

One insider, citing internal estimates from a major buyer, noted that as NVIDIA gradually ramps up production, China’s large cloud providers could obtain about 700,000 RTX Pro 5500 chips by the end of 2027, though final shipment numbers may still shift with NVIDIA’s capacity adjustments.

A NVIDIA spokesperson said U.S. companies are unfortunately constrained by two factors: outdated U.S. export regulations that still cover gaming products launched nearly five years ago, and China’s own restrictions on importing U.S. goods.
NVIDIA declined to comment on specific shipment volumes. Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance did not respond to requests for comment.

Insiders disclosed that NVIDIA has warned customers that, due to scheduling conflicts, capacity will remain tight for the foreseeable future. NVIDIA relies on TSMC (2330‑TW) to manufacture its AI chips, but as both companies shift more manufacturing resources to next‑generation products like Rubin, RTX Pro 5500 supply is expected to stay constrained.

U.S.–China export restrictions and memory shortages compress China’s chip supply. For national security and military reasons, the U.S. government bans NVIDIA from exporting its most powerful AI accelerators to China, fearing they could accelerate Chinese AI development and boost military capabilities. Although the Trump administration recently eased restrictions on some older‑generation chips, only a small amount of those products currently reaches China.

The Information reported in September that the Chinese government has signaled it may allow companies such as Alibaba and ByteDance to purchase RTX Pro 5500 chips. Reuters last month reported that Chinese firms have ordered more than 3 million NVIDIA chips in total.

Because NVIDIA chip supply is tight, China’s large cloud providers may continue shifting to domestic alternatives, buying AI inference chips from Huawei, Cambricon (688256‑CN) and Alibaba’s Pingtouge.

However, U.S. export limits on advanced chip‑making equipment and services, combined with a chronic shortage of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), continue to constrain Chinese chip makers’ production capacity and drive up product prices.
Cambricon’s latest financial report already reflects its production constraints; Huawei, China’s biggest AI‑chip supplier, raised the price of its top‑tier AI accelerator by 60% around September.
This article is not open for partner re‑publication.

items.title: 2000年來僅見五次！罕見指標示警：美股恐陷Fed救市困境
items.title_en: Only Five Times Since 2000! Rare Indicator Warns: US Stocks May Face Fed Rescue Dilemma
paras: 《MarketWatch》週二 (3 日) 報導，研究機構 Variant Perception 自行編製、用來衡量總體經濟環境對風險資產支持程度的指標，近期由偏多轉為中性。類似狀況自 2000 年以來僅出現五次，該機構因此建議降低股票比重、增加債券與現金，並嚴正警告，當前通膨偏高，可能限制聯準會 (Fed) 在市場動盪時放寬政策的能力。
Variant Perception 表示，這項「總體風險指標」(Macro Risk Indicator) 已連續數月走低，近期從有利於積極承擔風險的區間滑落至中性，反映總體環境對風險資產的支撐正在減弱。
該指標本世紀曾在 2000 年、2007 年、2010 年、2015 年與 2018 年出現類似轉變，但後續市場跌勢的嚴重程度不同。
Variant Perception 認為，關鍵在於市場承壓時，央行是否有空間透過寬鬆政策提供支援。
其中，2000 年與 2007 年的市場跌勢伴隨通膨上升，使央行放寬政策、挹注流動性的能力受限，最終造成較嚴重的市場損失。
相較之下，後三次回檔發生在通膨降溫的環境，貨幣當局得以較快轉向寬鬆，支撐市場與資產價格。
如今，整體通膨率約為 3.7%，聯準會仍處於緊縮模式。該機構認為，當前環境因此更接近 2000 年與 2007 年：一旦市場動盪，聯準會可能仍須優先處理物價壓力，無法立即提供投資人期待的政策支援。
展望後市，Variant Perception 將伊朗局勢、通膨、逐漸浮現的信用問題，以及人工智慧 (AI) 資本支出可能見頂，列為主要風險，預期各類資產的震盪可能延續至 2027 年第一季。
該機構預估，明年信用條件與流動性進一步收緊，將使企業融資與投資承受壓力，導致 AI 資本支出成長放緩，並增加信用風險事件。
這些壓力最終可能迫使聯準會轉向較偏鴿派的立場，但政策調整之前，市場仍須承受金融條件收緊的影響。
物價也可能面臨新的供給衝擊。Variant Perception 警告，聖嬰現象可能在能源價格上漲之外，再帶來食品價格壓力。
該機構援引圖表指出，氣溫異常變化約領先全球食品價格走勢 12 個月，意味著天候影響可能在未來一段時間逐步反映。
不過，該機構並未全面看空股票，企業獲利仍是重要支撐。其每股盈餘領先指標顯示，標普 500 指數 2027 年獲利成長可能優於市場目前預估的 16.3%，企業獲利展望的淨改善比例也持續上升。
這也是其將配置立場調整至中性，而非全面轉向避險的原因。
值得注意的是，此次訊號反映的是降低風險曝險的必要性，並不代表歷史上的嚴重跌勢必然重演。
在類股選擇上，Variant Perception 看好半導體的成長前景，並認為能源股在企業品質與合理估值的綜合評估下具有吸引力，同時加碼金融股。
相較之下，該機構建議減碼對高利率較敏感的小型股；醫療保健、軟體與民生消費類股則因成長較弱、估值要求較高，吸引力相對不足。
其配置方向是在降低股票整體比重的同時，保留成長與估值較具支撐的產業，以因應通膨壓力與流動性收緊並存的環境。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported on Tuesday the 3rd that research firm Variant Perception’s self‑compiled indicator measuring how supportive the overall economic environment is for risk assets has recently shifted from bullish to neutral. Such a shift has occurred only five times since 2000, prompting the firm to recommend lowering equity exposure, increasing bonds and cash, and warning that current elevated inflation could limit the Fed’s ability to ease policy during market turmoil.

Variant Perception said its "Macro Risk Indicator" has been trending lower for several months and has recently slipped from a range favorable to aggressive risk‑taking into neutral, reflecting weakening support for risk assets from the broader environment.
The indicator has shown similar turns this century in 2000, 2007, 2010, 2015 and 2018, though the severity of subsequent market declines varied.
Variant Perception believes the key factor is whether central banks have room to provide support through easing when markets are under pressure.
In 2000 and 2007, market declines coincided with rising inflation, limiting central banks’ ability to loosen policy and inject liquidity, ultimately leading to deeper market losses.
By contrast, the latter three pullbacks occurred in a cooling‑inflation environment, allowing monetary authorities to pivot to easing more quickly and support markets and asset prices.

Overall inflation is now about 3.7% and the Fed remains in tightening mode. The firm sees the current setting as closer to 2000 and 2007: if markets wobble, the Fed may still have to prioritize price pressures and cannot immediately provide the policy support investors hope for.

Looking ahead, Variant Perception lists Iran tensions, inflation, emerging credit issues and a possible peak in AI capital spending as primary risks, expecting asset‑class volatility to persist into the first quarter of 2027.
The firm estimates that tighter credit conditions and liquidity next year will pressure corporate financing and investment, slowing AI cap‑ex growth and raising credit‑event risk.
These pressures could eventually force the Fed toward a more dovish stance, but markets will have to endure the effects of tighter financial conditions before any policy shift.
Prices may also face new supply shocks. Variant Perception warns that the El Niño could add food‑price pressure on top of rising energy costs.
The firm’s chart shows that abnormal temperature changes lead global food‑price trends by about 12 months, implying weather impacts will gradually feed through over the coming period.

Nevertheless, the firm is not wholly bearish on equities; corporate earnings remain a key support. Its forward EPS indicator suggests S&P 500 earnings growth in 2027 could exceed the market’s current 16.3% estimate, with the net improvement in earnings outlook continuing to rise.
That is why it is moving its allocation stance to neutral rather than a full shift to defensive positioning.
It is important to note that this signal reflects the need to reduce risk exposure, not that past severe declines will necessarily repeat.
For sector selection, Variant Perception is bullish on semiconductor growth, finds energy stocks attractive on a blend of corporate quality and reasonable valuation, and is adding to financials.

Conversely, the firm recommends trimming exposure to small‑cap stocks that are more sensitive to high rates; healthcare, software and consumer‑discretionary stocks are seen as less attractive due to weaker growth and higher valuation demands.

Its allocation approach is to lower overall equity weight while retaining industries with stronger growth and valuation support, to navigate an environment of concurrent inflation pressure and tightening liquidity.

items.title: 〈分析〉蘋果跌2.5%反成買點？分析師喊370美元 看好AI服務變現
items.title_en: Analysis: Apple Drops 2.5% Then Becomes a Buying Opportunity? Analyst Calls for $370 Target, Bullish on AI Services Monetization
paras: 蘋果11月2日公布會計年度第四季財報，營收與獲利雙雙優於市場預期，iPhone與Mac銷售成長，12月季度營收展望也高於華爾街預估，但股價隔日不漲反跌，盤中一度下挫2.5%至329.79美元，終場收跌近2%，報331.90美元。
《巴隆周刊》分析指出，在大型科技股遭遇拋售、投資人重新檢視AI資本支出與獲利前景之際，蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 的股價拉回反而可能提供買進機會。相較於大舉投資AI資料中心的雲端巨擘，蘋果採取較節制的投資策略，讓它在科技股震盪期間具備一定防禦性。
截至11月2日收盤，蘋果今年股價累計上漲26%，遠優於標普500指數同期約11%的漲幅。不過，科技股近期賣壓也開始波及蘋果，顯示即使基本面相對穩健，仍難完全避開大型科技股整體估值修正。
市場對蘋果的防禦性評價，主要來自其AI投資模式與其他大型科技公司不同。微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US) 等雲端業者正大舉投入AI基礎設施，資本支出快速增加，也對自由現金流形成壓力；蘋果則持續增加研發投入，但規模遠低於雲端巨擘，並選擇與外部AI實驗室合作，而非獨力承擔整場AI軍備競賽的成本。
Aptus Capital Advisors股票主管暨投資組合經理David Wagner形容，蘋果是今年大型科技股中的防禦型標的。他指出，當市場資金追逐超大規模雲端業者及其龐大資本支出時，蘋果不必在AI軍備競賽中勝出，股價今年仍能上漲，對投資人而言相對具有安全感。
然而，蘋果的防禦性並不代表股價沒有風險。目前股價約為未來12個月預期盈餘的34.6倍，遠高於標普500指數約18倍的本益比。高估值意味市場已反映相當高的成長期待，一旦財報或未來展望出現任何不如預期之處，股價就更容易受到賣壓衝擊。
本季財報也存在幾項隱憂。服務營收略低於市場預期，公司並指出，若排除6月與9月季度的關稅退款影響，毛利率較前一季下滑約1個百分點。另一方面，記憶體價格上漲也成為市場關注焦點，零組件成本攀升可能侵蝕硬體產品利潤，讓投資人開始關注蘋果在銷售成長之外，究竟能保留多少獲利。
科技股整體環境同樣不利高估值個股。那斯達克指數在10月26日至30日當週下跌2%，Alphabet (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US) 與亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 等大型科技公司的財報表現及相關展望，引發市場不安，投資人對科技股的獲利品質、資本支出及估值要求也更加嚴格。
不過，歷史統計仍為蘋果多方提供支撐。根據道瓊市場數據，過去10年蘋果股價在財報公布後一個月上漲的機率為68%，一年後上漲的機率更達92%。這項統計顯示，財報公布後的短線波動未必代表中長期趨勢轉弱，但歷史表現也不能保證未來股價走勢。
Melius Research分析師Ben Reitzes維持蘋果「買進」評等，目標價設定為370美元。以11月3日盤中329.79美元計算，目標價代表約12%的潛在上漲空間。
Reitzes認為，服務業務重新加速成長，可能成為蘋果股價下一階段的催化劑。其中一項機會是iCloud+推出與Siri AI使用量連動的訂閱分級，藉由不同功能與使用需求設計收費方案；另一項則是AI助理未來可能帶來與交易相關的收入，進一步擴大服務業務的變現能力。
整體而言，蘋果目前面臨的是基本面穩健、估值偏高與成本壓力並存的局面。iPhone與Mac銷售成長、營收展望優於預期，顯示硬體需求仍有支撐；但服務營收不如預期、記憶體成本上升及毛利率壓力，讓市場不再只看營收成長，也開始檢視獲利能否同步擴張。
相較於必須投入龐大資本支出建置AI基礎設施的雲端業者，蘋果透過外部合作降低AI投資負擔，仍具有策略上的差異化優勢。不過，34.6倍的預期本益比已反映高度期待，未來若服務營收重新加速、AI功能成功轉化為訂閱與交易收入，才有機會進一步支撐估值；反之，若記憶體成本持續攀升並壓縮毛利率，股價也可能面臨更長時間的整理。
《巴隆周刊》因此認為，蘋果近期回檔可能是逢低布局的機會，但投資人仍須留意高估值與成本上升的雙重風險。蘋果能否維持大型科技股中的防禦性，關鍵將在於它能否把龐大的硬體用戶基礎轉化為更高的服務收入，同時守住產品毛利率。
paras_en: Apple released its fiscal fourth‑quarter results on November 2, reporting revenue and earnings that both beat market expectations. iPhone and Mac sales grew, and the outlook for the December quarter also topped Wall Street forecasts. Yet the stock fell the next day, sliding as much as 2.5% intraday to $329.79 and closing down nearly 2% at $331.90.

Baron Weekly’s analysis notes that as mega‑tech stocks are being sold off and investors re‑examine AI capital spending and profit outlooks, Apple’s pull‑back could actually present a buying chance. Compared with cloud giants that are pouring money into AI data centers, Apple’s more restrained investment approach gives it a defensive edge during tech‑stock turbulence.

As of the November 2 close, Apple’s shares have risen 26% year‑to‑date, far outpacing the S&P 500’s roughly 11% gain over the same period. However, recent selling pressure in the tech sector has begun to affect Apple, showing that even a relatively solid fundamentals story cannot fully escape a broader valuation correction in large‑cap tech.

The market’s defensive view of Apple stems mainly from its AI investment model, which differs from other big tech firms. Cloud players such as Microsoft (MSFT‑US) are heavily investing in AI infrastructure, rapidly expanding capex and pressuring free cash flow. Apple continues to raise R&D spend but at a scale far below the cloud giants, opting to partner with external AI labs rather than shouldering the entire AI arms‑race cost alone.

David Wagner, head of equities and portfolio manager at Aptus Capital Advisors, describes Apple as the defensive play among this year’s large‑cap tech stocks. He points out that when market capital chases the ultra‑large cloud firms and their massive capex, Apple does not need to win the AI arms race to keep its stock rising this year, offering investors a relatively safe haven.

Nevertheless, Apple’s defensiveness does not eliminate price risk. The stock now trades at about 34.6 times forward earnings for the next 12 months, well above the S&P 500’s roughly 18‑times price‑to‑earnings multiple. Such a high valuation implies the market has already priced in strong growth expectations, so any earnings miss or weaker outlook could trigger sharper selling pressure.

The current quarter’s filing also contains a few red flags. Service revenue fell slightly short of expectations, and the company warned that, excluding tariff refunds in the June and September quarters, gross margin slipped about one percentage point versus the prior quarter. Meanwhile, rising memory prices are drawing attention, as higher component costs could erode hardware profit margins and prompt investors to question how much profit Apple can retain beyond sales growth.

The broader tech‑stock environment is also unfriendly to high‑multiple names. The Nasdaq fell 2 % during the week of October 26‑30, and earnings and outlooks from large tech firms such as Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) sparked market unease, tightening investors’ standards for tech profitability, capex and valuation.

However, historical statistics still give Apple support. Dow Jones market data show that over the past ten years Apple’s stock has risen within a month of earnings releases 68 % of the time, and the one‑year post‑release upside probability climbs to 92 %. This suggests that short‑term volatility after earnings does not necessarily signal a weakening medium‑term trend, though past performance does not guarantee future results.

Melius Research analyst Ben Reitzes maintains a “Buy” rating on Apple with a target price of $370. Using the intraday price of $329.79 on November 3 as a reference, the target implies roughly a 12 % upside potential.

Reitzes believes a re‑acceleration of services growth could become the next catalyst for Apple’s stock. One opportunity is a tiered iCloud+ subscription linked to Siri AI usage, offering differentiated pricing based on features and demand. Another is potential AI‑assistant‑driven revenue from transaction‑related services, further expanding the monetization of Apple’s services business.

Overall, Apple faces a mix of solid fundamentals, elevated valuation and cost pressures. Strong iPhone and Mac sales and better‑than‑expected revenue guidance show hardware demand remains supportive, but weaker‑than‑expected services revenue, rising memory costs and margin pressure mean the market is now looking beyond top‑line growth to see if profits can expand in tandem.

Compared with cloud firms that must invest heavily in AI infrastructure, Apple’s strategy of leveraging external partnerships reduces its AI investment burden and provides a strategic differentiation advantage. Yet the 34.6‑times forward P/E already reflects lofty expectations; only if services revenue re‑accelerates and AI features translate into subscription and transaction income can the valuation be sustained. Conversely, continued memory‑cost inflation and margin compression could keep the stock in a prolonged correction.

Baron Weekly therefore sees Apple’s recent pull‑back as a potential low‑entry opportunity, but investors must remain mindful of the twin risks of a high valuation and rising costs. Apple’s ability to stay defensive among large‑cap tech will hinge on converting its massive hardware user base into higher services revenue while protecting product margins.

items.title: 民主黨將橫掃國會！美元重挫創一個月低　瑞郎、日元成避險贏家
items.title_en: Democrats Set to Sweep Congress! Dollar Crashes to One-Month Low, Swiss Franc and Yen Lead as Safe-Haven Winners
paras: 美國期中選舉初步結果顯示，民主黨預計同時拿下參眾兩院，全球市場迅速重新定價。美元指數今(4)日在亞洲匯市早盤交易時段一度跌0.4%，創10月2日以來最大跌幅，瑞郎則升值近1%、日元升0.7%，雙雙成為外匯市場最大贏家，澳元表現落後。
市場核心擔憂在於「AI監管升溫」。法國農業信貸銀行策略師David Forrester指出，美元此輪強勢高度依賴AI熱潮與科技股資金流入，若民主黨勝選拖慢資料中心建設、加強產業監管，美元將直接承壓。美股科技族群與AI概念股因此面臨估值重估。
債市則反向受益。若政治僵局限制進一步減稅與政府支出，美債供給壓力下降，10年期殖利率走低、債價上漲。
Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston指出，美元與美債實質殖利率同步走弱，加上對川普政府不確定性的對沖需求，推動今日亞洲早盤交易時段黃金買盤與期貨交易量明顯成長。
不過跌勢未必延續。三井住友日興證券的丸山凜人認為，若美伊談判破裂、油價反彈，通膨預期與Fed升息押注將重新升溫，進而支撐美元，且川普仍握有否決權，可擋下國會收緊AI監管的關鍵立法。短期「藍色浪潮」壓制美元，但地緣與政策反轉變數仍在。
paras_en: Preliminary results of the U.S. midterm elections show the Democrats are expected to win both chambers of Congress, prompting a rapid repricing in global markets. The dollar index fell 0.4% during the early Asian trading session on the 4th, its biggest drop since October 2, while the Swiss franc appreciated nearly 1% and the yen rose 0.7%, making them the biggest winners in the FX market, with the Australian dollar lagging behind.

The market’s core concern is “rising AI regulation.” David Forrester, a strategist at France’s Crédit Agricole, noted that the dollar’s recent strength has been heavily dependent on the AI hype and inflows into tech stocks; a Democratic victory that slows data‑center construction and tightens industry regulation would put direct pressure on the dollar. U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks could therefore face a valuation reassessment.

The bond market benefits in reverse. If a political stalemate curtails further tax cuts and government spending, pressure on U.S. Treasury supply eases, pushing 10‑year yields lower and bond prices higher.

Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, said the dollar and real U.S. Treasury yields weakened together, and hedging demand amid uncertainty over a Trump administration boosted gold buying and futures volume noticeably during today’s early Asian session.

The decline may not continue. Rintaro Maruyama of Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities believes that if U.S.–Iran talks break down and oil prices rebound, inflation expectations and bets on Fed rate hikes could heat up again, supporting the dollar. Moreover, Trump still holds veto power, which could block key AI‑regulation legislation in Congress. The short‑term “blue wave” may suppress the dollar, but geopolitical and policy reversal risks remain.

items.title_en: From 6 Trillion to 10 Trillion! NDRC Unveils the 15‑Year‑Plan Blueprint – Six Emerging Pillars such as Semiconductors, Biomedicine and Aerospace Enter a Golden Era
paras: 中國國家發改委周二(三日)召開「奮進『十五五』」系列記者會，明確提出到中國「十五五」計畫末期，新興支柱產業產值有望翻一番，突破10兆元(人民幣，下同)大關，成為支撐經濟高質量發展的新動能。
中國發改委創新和高技術發展司副司長任中保表示，中國新興支柱產業已具相當規模，去年產值接近6兆元，各產業基本形成完整產業鏈與供應鏈。「十五五」期間將重點培育集成電路、航空航天、生物醫藥等六大新興支柱產業，成長空間持續擴大。
從最新數據來看，產業動能已開始加速釋放。今年前三季，積體電路產量達4428億塊，年增23.3%；創新藥對外技術授權約1300億美元，已接近2025年全年水準，顯示高技術產業正從「規模擴張」轉向「價值輸出」。
政策面上，中國發改委將重點布局科教基礎設施與國家重大科技基礎設施，組織實施一批國家科技計畫，推動重點領域關鍵核心技術攻關取得決定性突破。同時強化自主創新產品推廣，落實首台(套)、首批次、首版次應用政策，形成「以用促研、迭代升級」良性循環。
資金端則統籌多種管道，加大財政、金融等政策支援，引導社會資本投入中國新興支柱產業。市場分析認為，10兆人民幣產值目標不僅是單純數字承諾，更意味著半導體、生物科技、高端裝備等戰略產業將迎來一輪結構性資源重配。
業內人士指出，從6兆向10兆躍進的關鍵，在於核心技術自主化與應用場景落地能否同步推進；若產學研與資本市場形成合力，「十五五」期間新興產業有望從政策驅動切換至內生增長，成為下一階段中國經濟最關鍵的邊際變量。
paras_en: On Tuesday (the 3rd), China’s National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) held a press conference titled “Advancing the 15‑Year‑Plan” and explicitly stated that by the end of the 15‑Year‑Plan period, the output value of emerging pillar industries is expected to double, breaking the 10‑trillion‑yuan (RMB) threshold and becoming a new engine for high‑quality economic development.

Ren Zhongbao, deputy director of the NDRC’s Department of Innovation and High‑Tech Development, said China’s emerging pillar industries have already reached a considerable scale, with last year’s output value close to 6 trillion yuan, and each sector having essentially complete industry and supply chains. During the 15‑Year‑Plan, the focus will be on cultivating six emerging pillars – integrated circuits, aerospace, biomedicine and others – with continued expansion of growth space.

The latest data show that industry momentum is already accelerating. In the first three quarters of this year, integrated‑circuit production reached 442.8 billion chips, up 23.3% year‑on‑year; licensing of innovative drug technologies abroad amounted to about $130 billion, already near the projected full‑year level for 2025, indicating that high‑tech industries are shifting from “scale expansion” to “value export.”

On the policy side, the NDRC will prioritize the layout of basic scientific‑education infrastructure and major national science‑technology facilities, organize a batch of national science‑technology projects, and push for decisive breakthroughs in key core technologies in priority fields. At the same time, it will strengthen the promotion of independently developed products and implement policies for the first‑of‑its‑kind (first unit, first batch, first version) applications, creating a virtuous cycle of “use‑driven research and iterative upgrades.”

Financially, the commission will coordinate multiple channels, increase fiscal and financial policy support, and guide social capital into China’s emerging pillar industries. Market analysts say the 10‑trillion‑yuan output target is not merely a numeric pledge; it signals that strategic sectors such as semiconductors, biotechnology and high‑end equipment will undergo a round of structural resource reallocation.

Industry insiders note that the key to jumping from 6 trillion to 10 trillion lies in whether core‑technology self‑reliance and application‑scenario implementation can advance in tandem. If academia, research, industry and capital markets form a joint force, emerging industries could shift from policy‑driven growth to endogenous growth during the 15‑Year‑Plan, becoming the most critical marginal variable for China’s next‑stage economy.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉「藍色浪潮」料橫掃國會 華爾街下一階段走向何方？
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: ‘Blue Wave’ Expected to Sweep Congress – What’s Next for Wall Street?
paras: 美國期中選舉初步開票結果顯示民主黨表現強勁，市場對民主黨橫掃國會兩院「藍色浪潮」(Blue Wave)的押注急劇升溫。預測平台 Polymarket 上民主黨同時掌控國會兩院的機率衝上 99%，Kalshi 顯示民主黨贏得眾議院與參議院的機率分別達 99% 與 98%。
選前華爾街的主流定價多建立在「分裂政府」(Divided Government)情景之上，當國會控制權轉向藍潮，全球金融市場隨即迎來即時調整。

選情震盪與華爾街資產即時反應

選舉結果公布初期的資產價格變化，呈現出清晰的結構性特徵，而非無差别的避險殺盤。美股期貨出現分化下挫，其中科技股集中的那斯達克 100 指數期貨重挫 2%，標普 500 指數期貨下跌約 0.9%，道瓊指數期貨僅微跌 0.3%。
與此同時，美元指數日內跌幅超過 0.5%，美國 10 年期公債殖利率則下行約 7 個基點至4.89%。
華爾街分析指出，資產價格的重估指向了兩大核心邏輯：一方面，國會分裂或財政約束預期對公債形成利多；另一方面，民主黨若全面掌權，對人工智慧(AI)與科技供應鏈政策的監管審查恐顯著收緊，直接對科技股評價造成壓頭。

92%勝率紀錄面臨考驗

歷史統計數據為選後股市表現提供了強勁的正面支撐，據德意志銀行(Deutsche Bank) 統計，自 1946 年二戰以來，標普 500 指數於期中選舉後 12 個月內 20 次全數上漲，平均漲幅達 14.4%；若將時間跨度拉回 1930 年，24 次選舉中有 22 次上漲，勝率高達 92%。
金融機構 Edward Jones 的數據指出，自 1970 年以來，標普 500 在期中選舉後 1 個月平均上漲 1.7%，選後 6 個月平均漲幅達 15.5%。
摩根士丹利補充，在共和黨總統執政期間，若期中選舉後國會呈現分裂狀態，標普 500 隨後一年的平均漲幅高達 23%，高於民主黨掌控兩院時的 16%。Principal Asset Management 市場策略師 Magdalena Ocampo 表示，儘管投票前後市場難免波動，但隨著政治不確定性消退，焦點終將回歸經濟基本面。
FHN Financial 首席經濟學家 Chris Low 分析，政治僵局降低了重大政策變動的風險，創造出可預測的環境，有利於企業進行長期投資與提升獲利。
然而，德意志銀行與摩根士丹利同時警告，本次市場結構存在顯著例外：當前標普 500 指數的「權重集中度」處於歷史最高水準。 德意志銀行指出，少數幾檔超大市值科技巨頭暴露於 AI 資本支出敘事與潛在監管審查之下，若這些權重股出現回調，恐使這項保持多年的 92% 勝率紀錄面臨被打破的風險。

華爾街主要機構與專家觀點

各家機構對於選後 12 個月市場大方向仍多持正面態度，但在短期波動路徑與關鍵催化劑上存在分歧：

Evercore ISI 策略師 Julian Emanuel提出了精細的情景分析框架。在「國會分裂且無爭議」的基準情景下，標普 500 年終目標價為 7,750 點；若民主黨橫掃且發生選舉爭議，年末目標下修至 7,650 點，並視初期下跌為買入良機；若出現「藍潮 + 選舉爭議 + 地緣政治衝突升級」的三重疊加極端情景，標普 500 可能拉回逾 10% 至 6,800 點，此時則不宜盲目逢低承接。
摩根士丹利首席美股策略師 Mike Wilson採取「先經歷波動，再進行買入」的立場。他認為期中選舉、AI 支出壓力與流動性收緊等出清事件，可能將標普 500 推低至約 7,100 點(回撤約 9%)，但隨著事件平息，指數將朝 8,000 點回升。Wilson 特別提醒，民主黨優勢擴大將增加對 AI 數據中心的監管與地方審查阻力。
Yardeni Research 總裁 Ed Yardeni提醒市場注意超過 40 兆美元的聯邦債務問題，指出國會僵局若引發發債規模擴大，可能干擾公債殖利率走勢並壓抑美股估值。但他強調，鑑於美國經濟與企業獲利基本面依然堅實，若「藍色浪潮」引發顯著賣壓，應視為逢低布局的買入機會。
Raymond James 首席投資策略師 Larry Adam 將政治列為 10 大市場驅動因素中的第 8 位，權重低於經濟成長與聯邦準備理事會(Fed)貨幣政策。政策分析師 Ed Mills 則聚焦政策細節，指出民主黨掌握眾議院後獲得的調查權與傳票權，將放大公眾對數據中心快速擴張的疑慮。
TD Cowen 金融政策分析師 Jaret Seiberg認為。民主黨掌控參議院將提高其角力籌碼，可逼迫行政機關填補聯邦存款保險公司(FDIC)、證券交易委員會(SEC)及商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)等獨立機構的民主黨席次
；參議員 Elizabeth Warren 若接掌參議院銀行委員會，可能推動更多民粹主義金融法案。

跨資產與產業潛在影響

資產配置方面，專家普遍認為，藍潮對大盤指數的影響相對溫和，但對不同行業內部的相對定價影響劇烈。
Wellington Management 債券基金經理人 Brij Khurana 表示，分裂政府限制了高財政支出的擴張，歷史上對美國公債相對有利。市場短期定價「財政約束」有利於美債殖利率下行，而美元指數則同時承受財政約束預期與風險偏好收縮的雙重壓力。
潛在受益與防禦領域：清潔能源領域(如 First Solar、Sunrun、Enphase、NextEra)因《通膨削減法案》的稅額扣抵政策得以延續而受惠；住宅建築與醫療保健政策風險較小。瑞銀(UBS)補充，兩黨在加快能源基礎設施審批與支持核電發展上仍存在合作空間。
承壓與監管領域：AI 與數據中心相關標的(如數據中心 REITs、新興雲端服務商)面臨國會聽證與地方政府許可摩擦的雙重壓力；國防預算可能面臨更嚴格的審查；加密貨幣監管方向可能從「鬆綁」轉向「消費者保護優先」。
paras_en: Preliminary results from the U.S. midterm elections show a strong showing for Democrats, and the market’s bet on a congressional "Blue Wave" has surged. On the prediction platform Polymarket, the probability of Democrats controlling both chambers rose to 99%, while Kalshi shows a 99% chance of winning the House and 98% for the Senate.
Wall Street’s pre‑election pricing was largely built on a "Divided Government" scenario; a shift to a blue‑wave majority would trigger an immediate adjustment across global financial markets.

Asset prices reacted sharply in the early hours after the results were announced, showing clear structural patterns rather than a blanket flight to safety. U.S. equity futures diverged, with the tech‑heavy Nasdaq‑100 futures plunging 2%, S&P 500 futures down about 0.9%, and Dow futures slipping only 0.3%.
At the same time, the U.S. dollar index fell more than 0.5% intraday, and the 10‑year Treasury yield slipped roughly 7 basis points to 4.89%.

Wall Street analysts say the re‑pricing reflects two core logics: on one hand, a divided Congress or expectations of fiscal constraints are bullish for Treasuries; on the other, full Democratic control could tighten regulation of AI and tech supply‑chain policies, putting downward pressure on tech‑stock valuations.

A 92% win‑rate record is being tested. Historical data give a strong positive bias to post‑election market performance. Deutsche Bank notes that since 1946, the S&P 500 has risen in all 20 midterm‑post‑12‑month periods, averaging a 14.4% gain; extending back to 1930, 22 of 24 elections saw gains, a 92% success rate.
Data from Edward Jones show that since 1970 the S&P 500 has risen an average of 1.7% one month after a midterm and 15.5% after six months.

Morgan Stanley adds that when the GOP holds the presidency and Congress is split after a midterm, the S&P 500’s average gain over the following year is 23%, higher than the 16% average when Democrats control both chambers. Principal Asset Management strategist Magdalena Ocampo says that while markets will wobble around the vote, political uncertainty will fade and focus will return to fundamentals.

FHN Financial chief economist Chris Low argues that a political stalemate reduces the risk of major policy shifts, creating a predictable environment that benefits long‑term corporate investment and profitability.

However, Deutsche Bank and Morgan Stanley warn of a notable exception in the current market structure: the S&P 500’s weight concentration is at an all‑time high. Deutsche Bank points out that a handful of mega‑cap tech giants, heavily exposed to AI cap‑ex narratives and potential regulatory scrutiny, could trigger a break in the long‑standing 92% win‑rate if they pull back.
Wall Street institutions and experts share their views. Most remain bullish on the 12‑month post‑election outlook, but they differ on short‑term volatility paths and key catalysts.

Evercore ISI strategist Julian Emanuel presented a detailed scenario framework. In a baseline "divided Congress, no dispute" case, the S&P 500 year‑end target is 7,750 points; if Democrats sweep and an election dispute arises, the target is trimmed to 7,650 points, with early declines seen as buying opportunities; in a triple‑stress extreme of "Blue Wave + election dispute + heightened geopolitical tension," the index could fall over 10% to 6,800 points, at which point buying on dips would be ill‑advised.

Morgan Stanley U.S. equity chief strategist Mike Wilson takes a "wait for volatility, then buy" stance. He believes the midterms, AI‑spending pressure, and tightening liquidity could push the S&P 500 down to around 7,100 points (a ~9% pullback), but the index should rebound toward 8,000 as events settle. Wilson cautions that a stronger Democratic majority would increase regulatory and local scrutiny of AI data centers.

Yardeni Research president Ed Yardeni warns of the more than $40 trillion federal debt, noting that a congressional deadlock that expands borrowing could disrupt Treasury yields and suppress equity valuations. Still, he stresses that the U.S. economy and corporate earnings fundamentals remain solid, and any sharp sell‑off from a "Blue Wave" should be viewed as a buying opportunity at lower levels.

Raymond James chief investment strategist Larry Adam ranks politics eighth among the top ten market drivers, behind growth and Fed policy. Policy analyst Ed Mills focuses on details, saying Democratic control of the House will boost investigative and subpoena powers, amplifying public concerns over rapid data‑center expansion.

TD Cowen financial policy analyst Jaret Seiberg argues that Democratic control of the Senate would increase its leverage, pressuring the administration to fill Democratic seats on independent agencies such as the FDIC, SEC and CFTC.
Senator Elizabeth Warren, if she chairs the Senate Banking Committee, could push more populist financial legislation.
Cross‑asset and sector impacts: experts generally see the blue‑wave effect on broad indices as modest, but expect pronounced relative pricing shifts across industries.

Wellington Management bond fund manager Brij Khurana notes that a divided government limits high‑fiscal‑spending expansions, historically benefiting U.S. Treasuries. Short‑term pricing of "fiscal constraints" supports lower yields, while the dollar faces dual pressure from fiscal‑constraint expectations and shrinking risk appetite.

Potential beneficiaries and defensive areas: clean‑energy names such as First Solar, Sunrun, Enphase and NextEra stand to gain from continued tax credits under the Inflation Reduction Act; residential construction and healthcare face relatively low policy risk. UBS adds that both parties still have room to cooperate on speeding up energy‑infrastructure approvals and supporting nuclear power.

Pressure and regulatory zones: AI and data‑center related stocks (including data‑center REITs and emerging cloud providers) face heightened congressional hearings and local permitting friction; defense spending may encounter stricter review; crypto regulation could shift from a "light‑touch" approach to one prioritising consumer protection.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨橫掃參眾兩院、德州變天！反資料中心新州長上位 AI概念股慘跌
items.title_en: US Midterm Election: Democrats Sweep Congress, Texas Flips! Anti‑Data‑Center Governor Takes Office, AI Concept Stocks Plunge
paras: 人工智慧(AI)概念股在美國當地周二(3日)晚間壓力沉重，主因是被外界視為支持暫停興建資料中心的民主黨在期中選舉中大獲全勝，更在科技重鎮德州的州長選舉中拿下關鍵勝利，加深市場對AI資料中心產業的疑慮。
科技股占比高的那斯達克100期貨一度下跌2%，跌幅是道瓊期貨的兩倍以上，State Street 科技精選行業SPDR ETF)(XLK-US)在Robinhood交易平台也下跌2%。
與資料中心投資直接相關的個股跌幅更大，為資料中心建設融資的雲端運算業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，在Robinhood下跌7%，同業Nebius Group(NBIS)下跌4%。總部位於德州、馬斯克旗下與AI資料中心相關的SpaceX(SPCX-US)下跌6%。甲骨文(ORCL-US)在Robinhood也下跌4%。
雖然科技股原本就因為市場預期民主黨將拿下眾議院，甚至可能掌控參議院而欲振乏力，但隨著票數陸續開出，德州州長寶座民主黨候選人希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)擊敗現任共和黨州長艾伯特(Greg Abbott)，對科技股可說帶來更大的衝擊。
Horizon Investments投資長Scott Ladner周二稍早在開票結果陸續出爐時說：「真正可能撼動市場的一件事是，假如艾伯特輸掉德州州長選舉，資料中心究竟要蓋在哪裡？」
Ladner補充說：「德州一直是適合興建資料中心的沃土。如果他落敗，我認為這片沃土很大程度上就會變得貧瘠。因此，這將是一項挑戰。」
希諾霍薩將成為德州史上首位拉丁裔女性州長，她向來公開支持暫停興建AI資料中心。根據富國銀行(Wells Fargo)估算，美國已規劃資料中心的總用電容量中，有27%位於德州。

AI交易面臨「左尾風險」

AI投資交易前陣子就因為AI投資回報而飽受壓力，那斯達克100指數在10月底收盤時已從近期高點回跌至少10%，落入「修正」區間。
如今民主黨拿下德州州長選舉，AI交易面臨更大風險。富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon警告：「我們認為，期中選舉後股市的反應，主要取決於德州州長選舉結果。若民主黨勝出，可能成為AI交易面臨的左尾風險事件(left-tail event )。」
在其他重要資料中心所在州，民主黨也可望將贏得或保住州長職位，包括喬治亞州、賓州及俄亥俄州。富國銀行預估，喬治亞州占全美已規劃資料中心總用電容量的7%，俄亥俄州與賓州則各占5%。
美國銀行(BofA)知名投資策略師Michael Hartnett今年稍早曾警告，如果民主黨拿下參議院，同時取得德州州長職位，可能導致股市到年底前大幅下跌逾10%。
Optimal Advisory華盛頓政策團隊本周稍早撰文指出：「資料中心在2024年和2025年還是廣受歡迎的經濟發展工具，但隨著期中選舉競選活動升溫，卻逐漸變成不受歡迎的對象。」
該團隊進一步寫道：「期中選舉可能向地方及州政府官員傳達一項訊息：阻止、延後資料中心建設，或提高建置成本，在政治上可能帶來好處。」
paras_en: AI‑related stocks took a heavy hit on Tuesday night in the US, mainly because the Democratic Party—viewed as supportive of pausing data‑center construction—won a landslide victory in the midterms and secured a key win in the Texas governor’s race, deepening market doubts about the AI data‑center industry.

The tech‑heavy Nasdaq‑100 futures fell as much as 2%, a drop more than twice that of the Dow futures, and the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK‑US) on the Robinhood platform also slipped 2%.

Stocks directly tied to data‑center investment fell even more: cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), which finances data‑center builds, dropped 7% on Robinhood, while peer Nebius Group (NBIS) fell 4%. Texas‑based SpaceX (SPCX‑US), the Elon Musk company linked to AI data centers, slid 6%, and Oracle (ORCL‑US) was down 4% on Robinhood.

Although tech stocks were already under pressure as the market anticipated a Democratic takeover of the House and possibly the Senate, the unfolding vote counts and the defeat of incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott by Democratic candidate Gina Hinojosa in Texas added an even bigger shock to the sector.

Scott Ladner, Chief Investment Officer at Horizon Investments, said on Tuesday as results kept coming in: “The real market‑shaker could be, if Abbott loses the Texas governor’s race, where the data centers will actually be built?”
Ladner added, “Texas has long been fertile ground for data‑center construction. If he’s defeated, I think that fertile ground will become largely barren. That will be a challenge.”

Hinojosa will become Texas’s first Latina governor and has publicly backed a pause on AI data‑center construction. According to Wells Fargo, 27% of the United States’ planned data‑center electricity capacity is located in Texas.

AI trading faces a “left‑tail risk.” Earlier, AI‑related investments were already under pressure from profit‑taking; the Nasdaq‑100 index had fallen at least 10% from its recent highs by the end of October, entering a correction zone.

Now that Democrats have won the Texas governor’s race, AI trading faces even greater risk. Wells Fargo chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon warned, “We believe the market’s reaction after the midterms will hinge largely on the Texas governor’s outcome. If Democrats win, it could become a left‑tail risk event for AI trading.”

In other key data‑center states, Democrats are also poised to win or retain governorships, including Georgia, Pennsylvania and Ohio. Wells Fargo estimates Georgia accounts for 7% of the nation’s planned data‑center electricity capacity, while Ohio and Pennsylvania each represent about 5%.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett warned earlier this year that if Democrats capture the Senate and also take the Texas governor’s seat, the stock market could tumble more than 10% by year‑end.

Optimal Advisory’s Washington policy team wrote earlier this week that “data centers will remain popular economic development tools in 2024 and 2025, but as the midterm campaign heats up, they are gradually becoming an unpopular target.”
The team added, “The midterms may send a message to local and state officials: blocking, delaying, or raising the cost of data‑center projects could have political upside.”

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨大勝已無懸念？Polymarket預測國會橫掃機率已超99%
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Democratic Landslide Almost Certain? Polymarket Predicts Over 99% Chance of Congressional Sweep
paras: 2026 年美國期中選舉開票作業緊鑼密鼓進行，去中心化預測市場平台掀起史無前例的押注狂熱。根據鏈上預測平台 Polymarket 交易數據，民主黨同時控制參眾兩院的勝率一度攀升至 99.6%，短短單日暴漲 24個百分點。
另一預測平台 Kalshi 的數據顯示民主黨贏得眾議院的機率高達 93% 至 99%，國會控制權市場的押注金額更突破數億美元。
美聯社與《華盛頓郵報》等媒體分析指出，民主黨在開票初期於參眾兩院取得顯著領先。民主黨欲重奪國會主導權，須在參議院翻轉 4 席、眾議院翻轉 3 席；開票結果甚至顯示傳統共和黨票倉德州也呈現偏藍趨勢，重創共和黨選情。
國會若遭到民主黨全面橫掃，將對川普政府產生重大的政治衝擊。分析師指出，一旦民主黨掌握兩院，川普在剩餘兩年任期內將面臨「跛腳鴨」困境，其稅改、醫療保健與移民等法案預算將受到嚴格限制。
StoneX 市場分析師Matt Simpson表示，市場對民主黨橫掃國會的預期，導致美國公債殖利率下滑與美元走弱，美股三大期貨指數量化下跌，顯示市場避險情緒升溫。
Simpson分析稱，政治僵局雖然會減緩川普的去管制化進程並增加對科技與 AI 產業的審查，但較低的殖利率可能支撐成長型股票的估值。此外，由於國會洗牌可能增加加密貨幣法案立法的不確定性，比特幣等加密貨幣在開票夜出現回吐漲幅與清算潮。
預測市場交易量的暴增，也引發監管機構與國會議員的強烈關切。《華盛頓郵報》報導指出，本次期中選舉相關交易額高達約 19 億美元。共和黨籍眾議員Blake Moore對此警告指出，允許政治顧問、民調機構與競選團隊人員參與預測市場下注，將創造「濫用預測平台」的機會，並呼籲立法限制與選舉相關的交易。
paras_en: The 2026 U.S. midterm vote count is progressing rapidly, sparking an unprecedented betting frenzy on decentralized prediction markets. According to on‑chain data from the Polymarket platform, the probability that Democrats will control both the Senate and the House rose to 99.6%, jumping 24 percentage points in a single day.

Data from another prediction platform, Kalshi, shows the odds of a Democratic win in the House ranging from 93% to 99%, with betting volume on congressional control exceeding several hundred million dollars.

The Associated Press, the Washington Post and other outlets note that Democrats took a clear early lead in both chambers as votes were tallied. To reclaim full congressional dominance, Democrats need to flip four Senate seats and three House seats; early results even show traditionally Republican stronghold Texas trending blue, dealing a blow to GOP prospects.

A full Democratic sweep of Congress would deliver a major political shock to the Trump administration. Analysts warn that if Democrats control both chambers, Trump will face a “lame‑duck” situation during the remaining two years of his term, with his tax, health‑care and immigration proposals likely to be severely constrained.

StoneX market analyst Matt Simpson said expectations of a Democratic congressional sweep have pushed U.S. Treasury yields lower and weakened the dollar, while the three major U.S. equity futures indices fell, reflecting heightened hedging sentiment.

Simpson added that while a political deadlock would slow Trump’s deregulation agenda and increase scrutiny of the tech and AI sectors, lower yields could support growth‑stock valuations. He also noted that the congressional reshuffle could raise uncertainty around crypto‑related legislation, causing Bitcoin and other digital assets to see profit‑taking and liquidation on election night.

The surge in prediction‑market trading has drawn strong concern from regulators and lawmakers. The Washington Post reported that total transaction volume tied to the midterms reached roughly $1.9 billion. Republican Representative Blake Moore warned that allowing political consultants, pollsters and campaign staff to bet in prediction markets creates opportunities for “abuse of prediction platforms,” and called for legislation to restrict election‑related trading.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉川普談共和黨敗因 油價比伊朗戰爭更傷、最大問題是「我沒參選」
items.title_en: <US Midterm Elections> Trump Discusses GOP Defeat: Oil Prices Hurt More Than Iran War, Biggest Issue Is “I Didn’t Run”
paras: 川普總統於表示，伊朗戰爭是共和黨在期中選舉遭遇慘敗的部分原因，但他堅持表示，自己並不後悔在今年早些時候發動這場戰爭。
在接受《華爾街日報》電話專訪時，當被問及這場戰爭是否導致共和黨選舉表現不佳時，川普表示：「伊朗因素確實占據了一部分原因。」
這場戰事拖累了川普的施政支持度，但他表示自己絕不反悔。數月來，他一直難以結束這場衝突，並屢屢向幕僚抱怨此事已成為揮之不去的沉重負擔。
但他強調：「我不會回頭去想，我做了對的事，就算重來一次我還是會做。」
川普認為，油價飆升才是最大的政治負擔，而非戰爭本身。受衝突影響，汽柴油價格大幅上漲，引發美國選民強烈不滿。
儘管共和黨在堪薩斯州、南卡羅來納州和德州等傳統深紅鐵票倉鎩羽而歸，且他在多州民調支持度大幅下滑，川普依然否認這次選舉結果是對其執政的嚴厲申斥。
他表示：「這只是單一時間點的結果，而且我本人並不在選票上。最大的關鍵在於選票上沒有我。」
川普主張，選民並非因為不滿經濟表現，或川普政府內部涉嫌貪腐，就否定共和黨。他也表示，不後悔在競選造勢期間未更頻繁談論經濟議題。
川普表明目前無意調整政府內部人事，並對主持戰事的國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth）表達全力支持，大讚「事實上我覺得他非常出色」。
不過，川普也坦承部分參選的共和黨候選人「表現確實有待商榷」。他指出：「其中有些人缺點太多，顯然無法獲得選民青睞。你知道的，我能做的也就這麼多。」
值得注意的是，週二落選的候選人中，有部分正是川普親自挺身背書的，包括南卡羅來納州共和黨參議員達琳·葛蘭姆（Darline Graham）。對此川普表示：「我試過幫他們了。」
川普並未質疑選舉結果的有效性，並表示期待與民主黨合作，但必要時會行使「否決權」。
他說：「我想我們會與民主黨合作，並能相處得很好。如果不成，我們就會對他們展現強硬態度，他們也會對我們一樣強硬。」
但當被問及認為能與哪些民主黨人順利合作時，他則未正面回答。
談到週二晚間揭曉的選舉結果，川普最終淡然表示：「世事本就如此，球有時就是會這樣彈。」
paras_en: President Trump said that the Iran war was one of the reasons the Republican Party suffered a crushing loss in the midterm elections, but he insisted he does not regret launching the war earlier this year.
In a phone interview with the Wall Street Journal, when asked whether the war had caused the GOP’s poor electoral performance, Trump said, “The Iran factor does account for part of the reason.”

The conflict has dragged down Trump’s approval for his administration, but he says he will not backtrack. For months he has struggled to end the fighting and repeatedly complained to staff that it has become a heavy, lingering burden.
He emphasized, “I won’t look back; I did the right thing, and even if I could do it again I’d do it again.”

Trump believes soaring oil prices are the biggest political burden, not the war itself. The conflict has pushed gasoline and diesel prices sharply higher, sparking strong voter dissatisfaction in the United States.

Even though the GOP fell in traditional red strongholds such as Kansas, South Carolina and Texas, and his poll numbers have dropped sharply in many states, Trump still denies that the election results constitute a harsh rebuke of his administration.
He said, “It’s just a snapshot in time, and I’m not on the ballot. The biggest issue is that I’m not on the ballot.”

Trump argues voters are not rejecting the Republican Party because of economic dissatisfaction or alleged corruption inside his government. He also said he does not regret not talking about the economy more frequently during campaign rallies.
Trump indicated he has no intention of reshuffling his administration and gave full support to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, praising him as “actually I think he’s doing an excellent job.”

However, Trump admitted that some Republican candidates who are running “have performance that really needs to be examined.” He said, “Some of them have too many flaws and clearly can’t win voters’ favor. You know, that’s about all I can do.”

It is noteworthy that among the candidates who lost on Tuesday were several personally endorsed by Trump, including South Carolina Republican Senate candidate Darline Graham. Trump said, “I tried to help them.”
Trump did not question the validity of the election results and said he looks forward to cooperating with Democrats, but will exercise a veto if necessary.
He said, “I think we’ll work with the Democrats and get along well. If not, we’ll take a hard line with them, and they’ll do the same to us.”
When asked which Democrats he thinks he could work smoothly with, he gave no direct answer.
Commenting on Tuesday night’s election outcome, Trump calmly said, “That’s just how the world works; sometimes the ball just bounces that way.”

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉民主黨橫掃國會！川普將成跛腳總統 共和黨恐陷路線「內戰」
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Elections: Democrats Sweep Congress, Trump Faces a Lame‑Duck Presidency, GOP Risks an Internal “Civil War” Over Direction
paras: 美國 2026 年期中選舉結果陸續出爐，《路透》等多家美國媒體週三 (4 日) 指出，民主黨已奪回參眾兩院控制權，終結共和黨全面掌控白宮與國會的局面。川普第二任期最後兩年的重大立法、人事任命與政府預算將面臨更強制衡，施政恐提前陷入「跛腳」困境，共和黨內部也可能因敗選爆發路線「內戰」。
這場被視為川普第二任期「期中考」的選舉，將使白宮從依靠共和黨多數推動政策，轉向更艱難的跨黨協商。民主黨除了能阻擋共和黨法案，也將掌握國會調查與人事審查工具，對川普政府施加更大壓力。
前白宮通訊主任、天橋資本 (SkyBridge Capital) 創辦人史卡拉穆奇 (Anthony Scaramucci) 在選前便預言，川普將遭遇「慘敗」。他警告，共和黨選後必須重新思考與川普及「讓美國再次偉大」(MAGA) 運動的關係，黨內恐爆發思想與路線之爭。
重大立法受阻 預算談判成角力焦點
新一屆國會明年 1 月上任後，川普將難以延續過去依靠共和黨票數推動重大法案的模式。新的重大稅制或支出政策，若無法爭取民主黨支持，就可能停滯。
其中，共和黨將無法再單靠本黨力量，運用「預算協調程序」推動重大財政立法。這項程序可讓符合規則的稅收與支出法案，在參議院免受冗長辯論阻撓，以簡單多數通過，但仍須取得兩院批准。
政府撥款、國防支出與舉債上限等議題，也將成為兩黨角力焦點。民主黨可透過協商，要求白宮調整政策或支出方向；川普若堅持原有立場，雙方談判可能更加艱難。若協商破裂，將增加政府停擺或債限僵局的風險。
不過，民主黨取得國會多數，也不代表能順利推動所有法案。參議院多數一般法案若遭冗長辯論阻撓，通常仍須取得 60 票才能終止辯論、推進表決，因此部分重大立法仍需跨黨支持。
人事任命與國會調查 白宮面臨雙重壓力
參議院易手，將直接影響川普的人事布局。須經參院同意的聯邦法官與重要行政官員提名，都可能面臨更嚴格審查，甚至遭到拖延或否決。
若最高法院出現職缺，大法官提名也須經民主黨把關，限制川普透過司法任命延續政策影響力的空間。參院民主黨領袖舒默 (Chuck Schumer) 已將阻擋川普任命 MAGA 路線法官，列為爭取參院多數的重要理由。
民主黨掌握兩院委員會後，也可設定聽證議程，並依相關規則運用傳票權，要求政府官員及相關企業提供文件、出席作證，追查政策決策、利益衝突與政府合作案。
史卡拉穆奇在選前表示，若民主黨拿下兩院，針對川普政府的國會調查將成為選後焦點，因為民主黨有許多希望追查的施政議題。
彈劾議題也可能再度升溫。不過，眾院通過彈劾條款並不等於免職，仍須交由參院審理，並獲出席參議員三分之二同意定罪，門檻遠高於一般多數。
川普揚言當「否決先生」 行政命令重要性升高
面對民主黨掌控的國會，川普仍握有總統否決權，可阻擋國會通過的法案。他在選前已表示，若民主黨贏得參眾兩院控制權，自己將化身為「否決先生」(Mr. Veto)。
民主黨若無法在兩院取得足夠票數推翻否決，仍須與白宮協商，才能將法案化為法律。這意味著，選後更可能形成行政與立法部門相互制衡、政策推進仰賴妥協的局面。
在立法空間受到壓縮之際，川普也可能更加依賴行政命令，在既有法定權限內推進政策，但相關措施仍可能遭遇司法挑戰。
對企業與投資人而言，國會權力易手將改變政策推進方式，政府撥款、稅制、監管與行政措施的變化，仍是後續觀察重點。
共和黨敗選後 恐爆發路線「內戰」
除了白宮與國會的權力拉鋸，共和黨也將面對敗選後的路線檢討。
據《CNBC》報導，史卡拉穆奇週二 (3 日) 在選前接受「Squawk Box Europe」訪問時直言：「我認為川普總統將遭遇慘敗，而且他自己也知道。」
他認為，選民對生活成本與政府施政的不滿，是川普面臨挫敗的關鍵。期中選舉是選民評價總統表現的重要機會，而民眾對政府表現並不滿意。
《CNBC》上月公布的全美經濟調查顯示，65% 受訪者不認同川普處理經濟的方式，使其經濟施政支持度降至新低；另有 80% 受訪者認為經濟狀況普通或不佳。
史卡拉穆奇指出，川普承諾改善生活負擔、不再捲入無止境的戰爭，並公開艾普斯坦案相關檔案，但他認為這些承諾未能兌現，正使部分 MAGA 陣營支持者與川普漸行漸遠。
他表示，共和黨已不再是雷根或小布希時代的政黨，接下來必須回答的問題是：當川普離開政治舞台後，共和黨是否仍要沿著他的路線前進？
不過，史卡拉穆奇認為，共和黨短期內難以擺脫 MAGA 運動。川普的政治影響力，以及其政治行動委員會掌握的數億美元資金，都將影響 2028 年共和黨總統提名競爭，使潛在參選人不願與他保持太遠距離。
因此，即使黨內出現路線之爭，下屆共和黨總統候選人的政策與政治訴求，仍可能保留 MAGA 元素。
史卡拉穆奇也對伊朗戰事的外交前景抱持悲觀看法，認為目前看不出伊朗、以色列與美國之間，存在足以促成協議的共同立場。他表示，戰爭不利企業經營與股市，希望各方透過談判化解衝突。
白宮未立即回應《CNBC》的置評要求。史卡拉穆奇曾在川普第一任期擔任白宮通訊主任，任職僅約 10 天；白宮此前曾批評，他的影響力早在近十年前就已結束。
市場反應
民主黨勝選消息陸續傳出後，市場對 AI 資料中心政策轉向的疑慮，尤其目前德州州長選舉翻盤，使投資人重新評估當地資料中心擴建前景，拖累 AI 與科技股在隔夜交易承壓。
那斯達克 100 指數期貨下跌約 2%，跌幅超過道瓊期貨的兩倍。
Robinhood 平台隔夜交易中，CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 下跌約 7%，Nebius (NBIS-US) 與甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 均跌約 4%。
Horizon Investments 投資長 Scott Ladner 表示，德州原本是資料中心建設的沃土，現任共和黨州長艾波特 (Greg Abbott) 敗選，可能使未來建置地點與擴張條件面臨更多不確定性。
現貨金上漲約0.5%，至每盎司3,947.49美元。美元走弱、美債殖利率下降支撐金價。Pepperstone 研究主管Chris Weston指出，投資人對川普政府後續政策不確定性的避險需求也是助力。
paras_en: U.S. 2026 midterm election results are coming in, and multiple American media outlets including Reuters reported on Wednesday (the 4th) that the Democratic Party has reclaimed control of both chambers of Congress, ending the Republican Party’s full domination of the White House and Congress. In the final two years of Trump’s second term, major legislation, appointments and the federal budget will face stronger checks, and his administration could stumble into a “lame‑duck” situation early, while the GOP may also see an internal “civil war” over strategy after the loss.

This election, seen as a mid‑term test of Trump’s second term, will shift the White House from relying on a Republican majority to push policies to a more difficult bipartisan negotiation. In addition to blocking Republican bills, Democrats will control congressional investigations and personnel‑review tools, putting greater pressure on the Trump administration.

Former White House communications director and SkyBridge Capital founder Anthony Scaramucci predicted before the election that Trump would suffer a “catastrophic defeat.” He warned that after the election the GOP must rethink its relationship with Trump and the “Make America Great Again” (MAGA) movement, fearing an internal battle over ideas and direction.
Major legislation blocked; budget talks become the focal point of the showdown

When the new Congress takes office in January next year, Trump will find it hard to continue the previous model of pushing major bills through sheer Republican numbers. New tax or spending policies that cannot win Democratic support are likely to stall.

The GOP will no longer be able to rely solely on its own ranks to use the “budget reconciliation process” to advance major fiscal legislation. That process lets tax and spending bills that meet certain rules pass the Senate with a simple majority, bypassing lengthy debate, but still requires approval from both chambers.

Funding allocations, defense spending and the debt‑ceiling will also become key battlegrounds between the parties. Democrats can negotiate to force the White House to adjust policies or spending; if Trump sticks to his original stance, talks could become even tougher. A breakdown would raise the risk of a government shutdown or a debt‑ceiling impasse.

However, Democratic control of the congressional majority does not guarantee smooth passage of every bill. In the Senate, most bills still face the threat of extended debate and usually need 60 votes to invoke cloture and move to a vote, so many major initiatives will still require bipartisan support.
Personnel appointments and congressional investigations put the White House under dual pressure

The shift in Senate control will directly affect Trump’s staffing plans. Nominees for federal judges and key executive officials who require Senate confirmation could face stricter scrutiny, delays or outright rejection.

If a vacancy opens on the Supreme Court, the nominee will also have to pass Democratic scrutiny, limiting Trump’s ability to extend his policy influence through judicial appointments. Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer has made blocking MAGA‑aligned judges a top reason for seeking the Senate majority.

With Democrats controlling both chambers’ committees, they can set hearing agendas and, under the rules, use subpoena power to compel government officials and companies to provide documents and testify, probing policy decisions, conflicts of interest and government contracts.

Scaramucci said before the election that if Democrats win both houses, congressional investigations of the Trump administration will become a post‑election focus, because Democrats have many policy areas they want to scrutinize.

Impeachment could heat up again. However, a House impeachment vote does not equal removal; the Senate must try the case and convict with a two‑thirds vote, a far higher threshold than a simple majority.
Trump has vowed to become the “Mr. Veto” as the importance of executive orders rises

Facing a Democrat‑controlled Congress, Trump still retains the presidential veto, which can block bills passed by Congress. He said before the election that if Democrats win control of both chambers, he will become “Mr. Veto.”

If Democrats cannot muster enough votes in both chambers to override a veto, they will still need to negotiate with the White House to turn legislation into law. This means the post‑election environment is likely to feature a balance of power between the executive and legislative branches, with policy progress depending on compromise.
With legislative space shrinking, Trump may lean even more on executive orders, pushing policies within his existing statutory authority, though such actions could still face judicial challenges.

For businesses and investors, the shift in congressional power will change how policies are advanced. Changes in federal spending, tax code, regulation and administrative actions will remain key points to watch.
GOP may face an internal “civil war” over direction after the loss
Beyond the power tug‑of‑war between the White House and Congress, the Republican Party will also have to reassess its post‑election strategy.
According to CNBC, Scaramucci told “Squawk Box Europe” on Tuesday (the 3rd) before the election, “I think President Trump will suffer a catastrophic loss, and he knows it himself.”

He believes voter dissatisfaction with cost‑of‑living pressures and the administration’s performance is the key reason for Trump’s setback. Midterms are a crucial moment for voters to evaluate the president, and the public is unhappy with the government’s performance.

A CNBC poll released last month showed that 65% of respondents disapproved of Trump’s handling of the economy, pushing his economic‑policy approval to a new low, while 80% said the economic situation was average or poor.

Scaramucci noted that Trump promised to ease living costs, end endless wars and release files related to the Epstein case, but those promises have not materialized, driving some MAGA supporters away from Trump.
He said the GOP is no longer the party of Reagan or the early Bush era; the next question is whether the party will continue on Trump’s path after he leaves the political stage.

However, Scaramucci thinks the GOP will not shake off the MAGA movement in the short term. Trump’s political clout and the hundreds of millions of dollars his political action committee controls will shape the 2028 Republican presidential nomination race, discouraging potential candidates from distancing themselves too far.
Thus, even if an internal battle over direction emerges, the next Republican presidential candidate’s policies and rhetoric are likely to retain MAGA elements.

Scaramucci also expressed a bleak outlook for the diplomatic prospects of the Iran conflict, saying there is currently no common ground among Iran, Israel and the United States sufficient to forge an agreement. He said the war hurts businesses and stock markets and hopes all sides will negotiate to end the fighting.

The White House did not immediately respond to CNBC’s request for comment. Scaramucci served as White House communications director for about ten days during Trump’s first term; the administration previously criticized him, saying his influence ended nearly a decade ago.
Market reaction

After news of the Democratic victory spread, markets grew wary of a shift in AI data‑center policy, especially after the Texas gubernatorial race flipped, prompting investors to reassess the outlook for local data‑center expansion and weighing on AI and tech stocks in overnight trading.
The Nasdaq‑100 futures fell about 2%, a decline more than twice that of the Dow futures.
On the Robinhood platform in overnight trading, CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) dropped about 7%, while Nebius (NBIS‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) each fell roughly 4%.

Horizon Investments’ chief investment officer Scott Ladner said Texas had been fertile ground for data‑center construction, but the defeat of incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott could introduce more uncertainty about future sites and expansion conditions.

Spot gold rose about 0.5% to $3,947.49 per ounce. A weaker dollar and falling U.S. Treasury yields supported the price. Pepperstone research head Chris Weston noted that investors’ hedging demand amid uncertainty over post‑Trump policies also helped lift gold.

items.title: 輝達RTX Pro 5500晶片供不應求！阿里、騰訊等中國企業訂單僅能到貨1%
items.title_en: NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 Chips in Short Supply! Chinese Companies Like Alibaba and Tencent Can Receive Only 1% of Their Orders
paras: 中國人工智慧（AI）業者對美國晶片大廠輝達(NVDA-US) 先進晶片的需求持續攀升，但受限於全球產能不足，實際到貨量恐遠低於預期。由於需求激增，輝達目前正努力擴大產能，但仍難以滿足市場需求。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士透露，阿里巴巴(09988-HK) 、騰訊控股(00700-HK) 、字節跳動（ByteDance）及其他中國AI與雲端服務業者，合計已訂購約600萬顆輝達 RTX Pro 5500 晶片。
然而，這些企業預估，未來4個月僅能取得數萬顆，約占訂單總量的1%。
知情人士指出，RTX Pro 5500 單顆售價超過1.1萬美元，累計訂單金額約達700億美元。中國大型雲端服務業者（Hyperscalers）對這款晶片展現強勁需求，凸顯中國國內AI運算能力嚴重短缺的問題，也暴露本土硬體製造商即使持續取得技術進展，仍存在能力限制。晶片供應不足，將使中國AI業者更難追趕美國市場領先企業。
儘管美國禁止輝達向中國出售最先進的AI晶片，但RTX Pro 5500尚未達到相關出口管制的限制門檻，因此仍可供中國市場採購。
不過，在中國本土供應商華為與阿里巴巴旗下平頭哥的技術及製造能力仍落後美國競爭對手之際，RTX Pro 5500已成為中國市場可取得的高階AI晶片之一。

輝達產能優先供應高階產品 中國訂單排隊等貨

輝達多年來持續遊說美國政府放寬對中國市場的晶片銷售限制，但全球製造產能不足，也使其難以滿足中國業者的採購需求。
全球AI晶片需求持續暴增，輝達目前將有限的產能優先分配給技術更先進、利潤率更高的產品，主要供應OpenAI、Anthropic等客戶。
知情人士表示，中國主要AI業者預計今年底前可收到首批數千顆RTX Pro 5500，明年2月左右再交付數萬顆，是目前僅有的兩批已確認出貨安排。
其中一名知情人士引述主要買家的內部估算指出，隨著輝達預計逐步提高產量，中國大型雲端服務業者估計，到2027年底可能取得約70萬顆RTX Pro 5500。不過，最終出貨數量仍可能隨輝達產能調整而有所變動。
輝達發言人表示，美國企業不幸持續受到兩方面限制，一是過時的美國出口管制規定，涵蓋近五年前推出的遊戲產品；二是中國自身對美國產品進口的限制。
對於具體出貨數量，輝達則未予評論。阿里巴巴、騰訊與字節跳動均未回應置評請求。
知情人士透露，輝達已向客戶示警，受產品排程衝突影響，未來一段時間產能都將維持吃緊。輝達仰賴台積電(2330-TW) 生產AI晶片，但隨著輝達與台積電將更多製造資源轉向Rubin等新一代產品，RTX Pro 5500的供應預料將持續受到限制。

美中出口限制與記憶體短缺 壓縮中國晶片供應

基於國家安全及軍事考量，美國政府禁止輝達向中國出口效能最強大的AI加速器，擔憂相關晶片將加速中國AI發展，並提升其軍事能力，儘管川普政府近期已放寬部分舊世代晶片的出口限制，相關產品目前僅有少量銷往中國。
《The Information》9月曾報導，中國政府已釋出訊號，可能允許阿里巴巴、字節跳動等企業採購RTX Pro 5500晶片。《路透》上月則報導，中國企業向輝達下訂的晶片數量已超過300萬顆。
由於輝達晶片供應緊張，中國大型雲端服務業者可能持續轉向本土替代方案，向華為、寒武紀(688256-CN) 及阿里巴巴旗下平頭哥採購AI推論晶片。
然而，美國對先進晶片製造設備與技術服務的出口限制，加上高頻寬記憶體（HBM）長期供應短缺，持續制約中國晶片業者的生產能力，也推高相關產品價格。
寒武紀最新財報已反映其生產能力面臨限制；中國最大AI晶片供應商華為則在9月前後，將旗下最高階AI加速器價格調漲60%。

paras_en: Demand for advanced chips from U.S. chip giant NVIDIA (NVDA-US) continues to rise among Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) firms, but global capacity constraints mean actual deliveries are likely far below expectations. While demand is surging, NVIDIA is working to expand capacity but still struggles to meet market needs.

According to Bloomberg, insiders say Alibaba (09988-HK), Tencent Holdings (00700-HK), ByteDance and other Chinese AI and cloud service providers have collectively ordered about 6 million NVIDIA RTX Pro 5500 chips.
However, these companies estimate that over the next four months they will receive only tens of thousands of units, roughly 1% of the total order volume.

Insiders note that each RTX Pro 5500 sells for more than $11,000, bringing the cumulative order value to about $70 billion. The strong demand from China’s large‑scale cloud providers (hyperscalers) highlights a severe shortage of domestic AI compute capacity and shows that even as local hardware makers make technical progress, they remain limited in capability. The chip shortage will make it even harder for Chinese AI firms to catch up with leading U.S. companies.

Although the United States bans NVIDIA from selling its most advanced AI chips to China, the RTX Pro 5500 does not yet fall under those export controls, so it can still be purchased for the Chinese market.

Nevertheless, with domestic suppliers Huawei and Alibaba’s Pingtouge still lagging behind U.S. competitors in technology and manufacturing, the RTX Pro 5500 has become one of the few high‑end AI chips available in China.

NVIDIA prioritizes capacity for its high‑end products while Chinese orders wait in line. NVIDIA has spent years lobbying the U.S. government to relax chip‑sale restrictions to China, but global manufacturing shortfalls also make it difficult to satisfy Chinese buyers.
Global AI‑chip demand continues to explode, and NVIDIA is allocating its limited capacity first to more advanced, higher‑margin products, mainly serving customers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

Insiders say China’s major AI firms expect to receive the first few thousand RTX Pro 5500 units by the end of this year, with another shipment of tens of thousands around February next year – the only two batches currently confirmed for delivery.

One insider, citing internal estimates from a major buyer, noted that as NVIDIA gradually ramps up production, China’s large cloud providers could obtain about 700,000 RTX Pro 5500 chips by the end of 2027, though final shipment numbers may still shift with NVIDIA’s capacity adjustments.

A NVIDIA spokesperson said U.S. companies are unfortunately constrained by two factors: outdated U.S. export regulations that still cover gaming products launched nearly five years ago, and China’s own restrictions on importing U.S. goods.
NVIDIA declined to comment on specific shipment volumes. Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance did not respond to requests for comment.

Insiders disclosed that NVIDIA has warned customers that, due to scheduling conflicts, capacity will remain tight for the foreseeable future. NVIDIA relies on TSMC (2330‑TW) to manufacture its AI chips, but as both companies shift more manufacturing resources to next‑generation products like Rubin, RTX Pro 5500 supply is expected to stay constrained.

U.S.–China export restrictions and memory shortages compress China’s chip supply. For national security and military reasons, the U.S. government bans NVIDIA from exporting its most powerful AI accelerators to China, fearing they could accelerate Chinese AI development and boost military capabilities. Although the Trump administration recently eased restrictions on some older‑generation chips, only a small amount of those products currently reaches China.

The Information reported in September that the Chinese government has signaled it may allow companies such as Alibaba and ByteDance to purchase RTX Pro 5500 chips. Reuters last month reported that Chinese firms have ordered more than 3 million NVIDIA chips in total.

Because NVIDIA chip supply is tight, China’s large cloud providers may continue shifting to domestic alternatives, buying AI inference chips from Huawei, Cambricon (688256‑CN) and Alibaba’s Pingtouge.

However, U.S. export limits on advanced chip‑making equipment and services, combined with a chronic shortage of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), continue to constrain Chinese chip makers’ production capacity and drive up product prices.
Cambricon’s latest financial report already reflects its production constraints; Huawei, China’s biggest AI‑chip supplier, raised the price of its top‑tier AI accelerator by 60% around September.

paras: 受美國期中選舉開票序盤顯示民主黨居於優勢影響，市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)與資料中心可能面臨更嚴格的法規監管，引發日本市場周三(4日)出現強烈避險情緒。
日股周三跌勢於午後擴大，日經平均指數一度大跌逾2,800點，跌幅達4.6%，下探60,206點，跌破被視為關鍵支撐的200日移動平均線61,880。東證指數(TOPIX)同樣重挫3.3%。相較於股市受創，匯市則湧入避險買盤，美元遭遇拋售，日元兌美元升值0.7%至157.65附近。
本輪賣壓集中於AI與半導體類股，愛德萬測試(Advantest)一度重挫9.6%、軟銀集團(SoftBank Group)大跌10%，鎧俠(Kioxia)暴跌15%。賣壓並擴散至商社、機械及金融等類股。
SMBC信託銀行投資調查部長山口真弘分析指出，日股先前因企業財報強勁獲買盤支撐，加上前一日適逢日本國定假日休市，導致投資人進行補跌平倉，以及信用交易籌碼面不佳，加劇了賣壓。
針對市場焦慮，機構法人看法分歧。野村資產管理首席策略師石黑英之認為，當前走跌屬投機資金根據「民主黨交易」進行的機械式拋售，市場過度焦慮且過於短視。他指出，AI發展攸關美中霸權爭奪，趨勢難以止步，隨著企業基本面維持強勁，加上空頭回補，後續股價有望回升。
大和資產管理首席策略師建部和禮表示，眾議院過半已在預期中，焦點在於參議院開票。若民主黨僅微幅控制參議院，賣壓將於短期結束；若大勝過半，AI逆風恐將延續更長時間。
在匯市與展望方面，SMBC日興證券資深策略師丸山凜途指出，雖然民主黨優勢推升日元至157關卡附近，但考量美中競爭與總統否決權，嚴格規制難以實施，美元賣壓終將反轉。
藍天銀行首席市場策略師諸我晃補充，若民主黨奪下兩院，初期市場反應為避險與美元走弱，但當前美元拋售亦受到美股期指疲軟與中東地緣局勢緩和等因素影響。
paras_en: The market, worried that artificial intelligence (AI) and data centers could face tighter regulatory oversight, reacted to early mid‑term election results showing a Democratic advantage, sparking strong safe‑haven sentiment in Japan on Wednesday (the 4th).

Japanese equities fell sharply in the afternoon, with the Nikkei index at one point dropping more than 2,800 points—a 4.6% decline—to as low as 60,206, slipping below the key 200‑day moving average support of 61,880. The TOPIX also plunged 3.3%. In contrast, the currency market saw a rush of safe‑haven buying, the dollar was sold off and the yen rose about 0.7% to around 157.65 per dollar.

The sell‑off was concentrated in AI and semiconductor stocks, with Advantest tumbling 9.6%, SoftBank Group falling 10% and Kioxia plunging 15%. The pressure spread to trading houses, machinery and financial stocks as well.

SMBC Trust Bank’s head of investment research, Masahiro Yamaguchi, said the market had previously been supported by strong corporate earnings and, after a Japanese national holiday the day before, investors were forced to cover falling positions and weak margin‑trading balances, intensifying the sell pressure.

Institutional views diverged on the market anxiety. Nomura Asset Management chief strategist Hideyuki Ishiguro argued that the current decline is a mechanical sell‑off by speculative money reacting to a “Democratic trade,” and that the market is overly anxious and short‑sighted. He noted that AI development is tied to U.S.–China rivalry, the trend is hard to stop, and with solid corporate fundamentals and short covering, stocks could rebound.

Daiwa Asset Management chief strategist Kazuhide Kenbo said that the House of Representatives already being expected to tilt Democratic is only part of the story; the focus now is the Senate count. If Democrats only gain a slim Senate majority, the sell‑off should end soon; if they win a large majority, the AI headwind could persist longer.

Regarding FX and outlook, SMBC Nikko Securities senior strategist Rinto Maruyama pointed out that although the Democratic advantage has pushed the yen toward the 157 level, given U.S.–China competition and presidential veto power, strict regulation is unlikely to be implemented, and dollar‑selling pressure will eventually reverse.

Blue Sky Bank chief market strategist Sho Wataru added that if Democrats take control of both chambers, the initial market reaction will be safe‑haven buying and a weaker dollar, but the current dollar sell‑off is also being driven by weak U.S. equity futures and easing Middle‑East geopolitical tensions.

items.title_en: <U.S. Midterm Election> Trump Speaks for the First Time: If I Were on the Ballot, the GOP Would Win "Overwhelmingly"
paras: 美國總統川普對期中選舉結果首次作出回應，給選民的傳達的訊息是要假裝他在選票上，還說「如果我參選了，我們會以壓倒性優勢獲勝！」
川普周二(3日)晚間在Truth Social上寫道：「選票上又沒有我的名字——如果我在選票上的話，我們絕對會以壓倒性優勢獲勝！感謝大家關注此事。」川普此前便曾為了拉高投票率，懇請選民們假裝他就是這次選舉的候選人。
不過，隨著共和黨在全美遭遇慘敗，白宮也因為聲稱「川普總統不在選票上」而備受譏諷。
白宮稍早發出一份聲明說：「川普總統並不在選票上，事實證明，當川普在選票上時，他的支持者才會出來投票。此外，候選人素質至關重要，且川普總統在為許多候選人宣傳造勢方面，做得比候選人自己還要好。」
一位白宮官員還說：「今天投票支持民主黨的人，等到美伊衝突解決、汽油價格迅速回落時，恐怕會深感後悔，因為屆時他們將不得不面對這群激進的自由派民主黨人。最後還要說的是，無論今天結果如何，川普總統阻止『激進左派』的決心只會愈發堅定。大家繫好安全帶吧。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump responded to the midterm election results for the first time, urging voters to pretend he is on the ballot and saying, "If I were running, we would win by an overwhelming margin!"

On Tuesday night (the 3rd), Trump wrote on Truth Social: "My name isn’t on the ballot—if I were on the ballot, we would absolutely win by an overwhelming margin! Thanks everyone for paying attention to this." Trump had previously asked voters to pretend he was a candidate in order to boost turnout.
However, as the Republican Party suffered a crushing defeat nationwide, the White House was mocked for claiming that "President Trump is not on the ballot."

Earlier, the White House issued a statement saying: "President Trump is not on the ballot; the facts show that when Trump is on the ballot, his supporters turn out to vote. Moreover, candidate quality is crucial, and President Trump does a better job promoting many candidates than the candidates themselves do."

A White House official added: "Those who voted for the Democrats today will likely regret it once the Iran‑U.S. conflict is resolved and gasoline prices fall sharply, because they will then have to face this group of radical liberal Democrats. In any case, regardless of today’s outcome, President Trump’s resolve to stop the ‘radical left’ will only grow stronger. Everyone, buckle up.

items.title: 民主黨將橫掃國會！美元重挫創一個月低　瑞郎、日元成避險贏家
items.title_en: Democrats Set to Sweep Congress! Dollar Crashes to One-Month Low, Swiss Franc and Yen Lead as Safe-Haven Winners
paras: 美國期中選舉初步結果顯示，民主黨預計同時拿下參眾兩院，全球市場迅速重新定價。美元指數今(4)日在亞洲匯市早盤交易時段一度跌0.4%，創10月2日以來最大跌幅，瑞郎則升值近1%、日元升0.7%，雙雙成為外匯市場最大贏家，澳元表現落後。
市場核心擔憂在於「AI監管升溫」。法國農業信貸銀行策略師David Forrester指出，美元此輪強勢高度依賴AI熱潮與科技股資金流入，若民主黨勝選拖慢資料中心建設、加強產業監管，美元將直接承壓。美股科技族群與AI概念股因此面臨估值重估。
債市則反向受益。若政治僵局限制進一步減稅與政府支出，美債供給壓力下降，10年期殖利率走低、債價上漲。
Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston指出，美元與美債實質殖利率同步走弱，加上對川普政府不確定性的對沖需求，推動今日亞洲早盤交易時段黃金買盤與期貨交易量明顯成長。
不過跌勢未必延續。三井住友日興證券的丸山凜人認為，若美伊談判破裂、油價反彈，通膨預期與Fed升息押注將重新升溫，進而支撐美元，且川普仍握有否決權，可擋下國會收緊AI監管的關鍵立法。短期「藍色浪潮」壓制美元，但地緣與政策反轉變數仍在。
paras_en: Preliminary results of the U.S. midterm elections show the Democrats are expected to win both chambers of Congress, prompting a rapid repricing in global markets. The dollar index fell 0.4% during the early Asian trading session on the 4th, its biggest drop since October 2, while the Swiss franc appreciated nearly 1% and the yen rose 0.7%, making them the biggest winners in the FX market, with the Australian dollar lagging behind.

The market’s core concern is “rising AI regulation.” David Forrester, a strategist at France’s Crédit Agricole, noted that the dollar’s recent strength has been heavily dependent on the AI hype and inflows into tech stocks; a Democratic victory that slows data‑center construction and tightens industry regulation would put direct pressure on the dollar. U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks could therefore face a valuation reassessment.

The bond market benefits in reverse. If a political stalemate curtails further tax cuts and government spending, pressure on U.S. Treasury supply eases, pushing 10‑year yields lower and bond prices higher.

Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, said the dollar and real U.S. Treasury yields weakened together, and hedging demand amid uncertainty over a Trump administration boosted gold buying and futures volume noticeably during today’s early Asian session.

The decline may not continue. Rintaro Maruyama of Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities believes that if U.S.–Iran talks break down and oil prices rebound, inflation expectations and bets on Fed rate hikes could heat up again, supporting the dollar. Moreover, Trump still holds veto power, which could block key AI‑regulation legislation in Congress. The short‑term “blue wave” may suppress the dollar, but geopolitical and policy reversal risks remain.

美國10月供應管理協會(ISM)製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)改善，但9月建築支出意外較前月大幅下滑，並據美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)季度調查，第三季企業向銀行貸款需求放緩，為逾一年來首見，而且美國中期選舉臨近，根據預測機構數據，民主黨同時贏得參、眾兩院的概率為72%，美國總統川普領導的共和黨保住參議院、民主黨贏得眾議院的機率為23%。共和黨同時保住參、眾兩院的可能性僅6%，共和黨面臨失去國會控制權，同時民意調查顯示川普支持率已跌至其政治生涯最低水平，加上油價暴跌、美國收益率回落及本周迎來美國勞動力市場數據和多家央行決策，週二推動美元兌日圓下探至157.43低點。

隨後美國公布9月工廠訂單與耐久財訂單修正分別較前月增加1.8%及1.9%優於預期，並據美國勞工部數據顯示，9月職位空缺猛增至752.3萬個高於預估值及裁員數降至一年半來最低，而且美國對伊朗的格什姆島發動襲擊後，總統川普威脅要再打擊伊朗，伊朗官員則稱，美國伊朗所提要求的回應缺乏說服力，引發中東緊張局勢升溫，推升美元兌日圓至158.76高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.70-90，支撐於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭公布9月經季節調整新住宅建築許可數意外降7.9%遜於前值，並據澳洲央行(RBA)上調隔拆利率上調25個基點至4.85%，為今年第五次升息，更創十八年來新高，RBA表示將繼續採取其認為必要的措施，以使通貨膨脹率達到目標水平，但表決結果為九名委員中有三人主張維持利率不變，RBA則刪除必要時進一步上調隔夜拆利率的表述，市場普遍認為RBA將暫停加息，打擊紐元及澳幣下跌，拖累歐元兌美元受限於1.1206高點。
據中國人民銀行(PBOC)宣布自11月15日起調升外匯存款準備金率2個百分點至6.0%，重創人民幣至兩周新低，加重澳幣作為其流動性替代貨幣的賣壓，並隨著美國中期選舉前，投資者保持謹慎，而且市場預期FED升息幅度將大於歐洲央行(ECB)，打壓歐元兌美元至1.1174低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1160-80，阻力於1.1245-65。
◆GBP/USD

美國科技板塊的擔憂情緒持續，損及市場信心，而且市場在週二美國中期選舉和週四英國央行(BOE)利率決議前，交投保持謹慎，但油價大幅下挫令英國受惠，週二支撐英鎊兌美元穩守1.3392低點，隨著此前PMI數據顯示，英國製造業在2026年第四季開局創下逾兩年來最強勁產出表現，並據路透調查，BOE將於週四上調指標利率至4.0%，為2023年8月意來首次加息，而且英國廣播公司(BBC)報導，歐盟執委會與英國就英國食品出口至歐盟達成協議，加上美國總統川普領導的共和黨面臨國會控制權保衛戰壓抑美元，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3435高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3410-30，阻力於1.3500-20。

Combined with a Republican‑led Congress fight that is suppressing the dollar, the pound rose to a high of 1.3435. GBP/USD support today is estimated at 1.3410‑1.3430, resistance at 1.3500‑1.3520.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元震盪 中東局勢與美國期中選舉帶來壓力
items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Oscillates as Middle East Tensions and U.S. Midterm Elections Add Pressure
paras: 美元周二(3日)在小幅上漲與下跌之間來回震盪，投資人評估美國與伊朗可能達成協議的不確定性，以及美國期中選舉的結果。另一方面，澳幣與人民幣則在各自央行採取政策措施後走弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.07%，報101.83。
投資人正評估美國期中選舉可能造成的市場影響，尤其關注美國國會控制權是否可能出現轉變，以及民主黨若表現強勁，是否會導致資產價格波動加劇，特別是近來一直是市場主要驅動力的 AI 交易。
由於伊朗戰爭停火談判傳出相互矛盾的訊息，油價劇烈波動，美元當天也在小幅漲跌之間來回震盪。
一名伊朗高階官員向《路透社》表示，伊朗與美國距離達成結束戰爭的協議仍有很大差距。同時，調停方卡達加強斡旋，試圖縮小雙方分歧，避免美國期中選舉後局勢再次升高。
此外，美國總統川普表示，他已與以色列總理尼坦雅胡(Benjamin Netanyahu)達成協議，華盛頓將在今年年底後停止對以色列提供40億美元的資金，但仍會繼續向該國出售武器。
Monex USA交易部門資深主管 Juan Perez 表示，「我們現在收到的訊息非常混亂……情況就像是前進一步，接著又倒退一步。這讓人有些困惑，也有些沮喪。」
他接著表示，「我整體的看法是，美元仍有下跌空間，部分原因在於，聯準會(Fed)內部如今已不再有一致共識。另一個因素是，如果政府或政治層面的摩擦增加，而這種情況發生的可能性更高，那麼很可能會對美元造成負面影響。」
美元當天一度下跌0.17%，但在美國勞工部公布職缺與勞動力流動調查 (JOLTS) 報告後轉為走高。報告顯示，衡量勞動力需求的職缺數增加33.3萬個，達752.3萬個，遠高於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的710萬個。
這項數據是本週一系列美國勞動市場報告中的第一份，後續將於週五公布政府非農就業報告。這些數據將有助於形塑市場對聯準會未來政策走向的預期。
美國商務部另一份報告顯示，9月美國工廠商品新訂單增加1.8%，高於預測的1.2%，部分受到飛機訂單增加的帶動。
澳幣與人民幣承壓
另一方面，市場也對中國與澳洲央行稍早公布的政策決策作出反應。
中國人民銀行提高金融機構必須持有的外匯存款準備金比例，以減緩人民幣近期升值的速度。受此影響，美元兌離岸人民幣上漲0.35%，至6.67，創下5月15日以來最大單日漲幅。
澳洲央行如市場預期，將現金利率調升25個基點至4.85%。這是今年第五次升息，決策結果為6票贊成、3票反對。澳幣盤中一度下跌0.51%，最新兌美元下跌0.4%，報0.6968美元。
高盛分析師在一份報告中表示，他們認為這項決策「略偏鴿派」，理由包括決策委員會投票結果出現分歧、聲明中刪除了強調緊縮傾向的措辭，以及更新後的預測顯示，截尾平均通膨率 (trimmed mean inflation) 到2028年第四季將放緩至2.4%。
本週還有其他央行將公布政策決策，包括英國、挪威與瑞典的央行。

paras_en: The dollar on Tuesday (the 3rd) swung back and forth between modest gains and losses as investors weighed the uncertainty over a possible U.S.–Iran agreement and the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections. Meanwhile, the Australian dollar and the Chinese yuan weakened after their respective central banks took policy actions.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.07% to 101.83.

Investors are assessing the market impact of the U.S. midterms, especially the prospect of a shift in control of Congress and whether a strong showing by Democrats could spark heightened asset‑price volatility, particularly in AI‑driven trading that has been a key market driver lately.
Conflicting messages from Iran‑war cease‑fire talks sent oil prices sharply up and down, and the dollar also oscillated within a narrow range on the day.

An Iranian senior official told Reuters that there remains a large gap between Iran and the United States on reaching a war‑ending deal. At the same time, Qatar, acting as a mediator, stepped up its efforts to narrow the differences and prevent the situation from escalating again after the U.S. midterms.

U.S. President Donald Trump also said he has reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Washington will cease providing $4 billion in funding to Israel after the end of this year, though it will continue to sell weapons to the country.

Juan Perez, senior head of the trading division at Monex USA, said, “The information we are getting now is very chaotic… it feels like taking a step forward and then a step back. It’s confusing and a bit frustrating.”

He added, “My overall view is that the dollar still has room to fall, partly because the Fed no longer has a unified consensus internally. Another factor is that if government or political frictions increase – which is more likely – it could have a negative impact on the dollar.”

The dollar fell as much as 0.17% during the day but turned higher after the U.S. Labor Department released its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS). The report showed job openings rose by 333,000 to 7.523 million, well above Reuters‑survey economists’ estimate of 7.10 million.

This data was the first of a series of U.S. labor‑market reports due this week, with the government’s non‑farm payrolls slated for release on Friday. Those figures will help shape market expectations for the Fed’s future policy path.
Another report from the U.S. Commerce Department showed that new orders for factory goods in September rose 1.8%, above the 1.2% forecast, helped in part by an increase in aircraft orders.
Australian Dollar and Chinese Yuan Under Pressure
Elsewhere, markets also reacted to policy decisions announced earlier by the People’s Bank of China and the Reserve Bank of Australia.

The People’s Bank of China raised the reserve‑requirement ratio for foreign‑exchange deposits that financial institutions must hold to slow the recent appreciation of the yuan. As a result, the offshore yuan rose 0.35% against the dollar to 6.67, marking the biggest single‑day gain since May 15.

The Reserve Bank of Australia, as markets expected, lifted the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85%. It was the fifth rate hike this year, with the decision passing 6‑3. The Australian dollar fell as much as 0.51% intraday and was down 0.4% at $0.6968 per U.S. dollar.

Goldman Sachs analysts wrote in a note that they view the move as “slightly dovish,” citing the split vote on the committee, the removal of language emphasizing tightening in the statement, and updated forecasts showing trimmed‑mean inflation slowing to 2.4% by Q4 2028.
Other central banks are set to announce policy decisions later this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Norway and Sweden.
The euro rose 0.07% against the dollar to $1.1193.
The pound sterling gained 0.11% against the dollar to $1.3418.

items.title: 中國央行調高外匯存準率至6%！在岸、離岸人民幣聞訊跳水 兌美元雙雙貶逾0.22%
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Raises FX Reserve Requirement Ratio to 6% – Onshore and Offshore RMB Plunge, Both Falling Over 0.22% Against the Dollar
paras: 中國在岸、離岸人民幣今(3)日兌美元雙雙貶值。截至當日9時35分，在岸人民幣兌美元匯率報6.6632，日內貶值0.23%，離岸人民幣匯率報6.6617，日內貶值0.22%，因為中國央行為加強金融機構外匯流動性管理，自今年11月15日起，上調金融機構外匯存款準備率2個百分點，即外匯存款準備率由現行的4%提高到6%。
此前，中國央行曾在關於人民幣匯率的政策立場中強調，向前看，影響人民幣匯率的因素較為多元，推動升值和貶值的因素都存在，匯率走向還有不確定性。
市場分析師認為，提高外匯存款準備率相當於在外匯市場上收緊了美元的供給和流動性，從而可以減輕人民幣升值的壓力，有助於人民幣對美元匯率保持合理均衡水平上的基本穩定。
今年以來，人民幣大幅升值，離岸人民幣兌美元走升約4.5%。今日，人民幣兌美元中間價調貶4個基點，報6.715，前一交易日中間價報6.7146。
paras_en: Onshore and offshore Chinese yuan both depreciated against the U.S. dollar today (the 3rd). As of 9:35 a.m. local time, the onshore yuan was at 6.6632 per dollar, down 0.23% intraday, while the offshore yuan was at 6.6617 per dollar, down 0.22% intraday. The move follows the People’s Bank of China’s decision to tighten foreign‑exchange liquidity management for financial institutions by raising the foreign‑exchange deposit reserve ratio by two percentage points, from the current 4% to 6%, effective November 15 of this year.

Previously, the PBOC emphasized in its policy stance on the yuan that looking ahead, the factors influencing the exchange rate are diverse, with forces pushing both appreciation and depreciation, making the future direction of the yuan uncertain.

Market analysts say that raising the FX deposit reserve ratio effectively tightens the supply and liquidity of dollars in the foreign‑exchange market, which can ease upward pressure on the yuan and help keep the yuan‑dollar rate at a reasonably balanced, fundamentally stable level.

Since the start of the year, the yuan has appreciated sharply, with offshore yuan gaining about 4.5% against the dollar. Today the central parity rate for the yuan was lowered by four basis points to 6.715, compared with 6.7146 in the previous trading session.

Because Iranian and Qatari officials continued negotiations to end the US‑Israel war with Iran, market expectations that disruptions to Middle‑East oil supply might ease rose, sending crude oil prices down about 7%.

In recent weeks, concerns have deepened that companies are pouring huge sums into emerging AI technologies, dragging down equity performance and giving the dollar a boost as a safe‑haven asset.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said, "Overall, the market has shown considerable resilience. December‑delivery West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures tested $105 a barrel on Friday and have now slipped below $100."

He added, "Going into the weekend, market conditions looked pretty grim. Stocks were falling and December WTI futures had even set a new contract high. But after the weekend, when trading resumed, the market collectively seemed to breathe a sigh of relief."
Even though Fitch last Friday downgraded France’s credit outlook from "stable" to "negative" amid worsening debt conditions, the euro still rose 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1192.
October manufacturing index rises

On the data front, the US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the October manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 from September’s 54.5, indicating continued expansion in factory activity while input costs remain elevated.
The market this week will also see a slew of labor‑market data, with Friday’s US non‑farm payroll report slated as the headline event.

S&P Global’s euro‑area manufacturing PMI showed that October manufacturing activity in the euro zone remained robust, though growth slowed slightly as new‑order growth decelerated and higher energy prices and supply‑chain disruptions pushed up costs, further squeezing corporate profit margins.
Several central banks are also expected to announce policy decisions this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Australia, Norway and Sweden.

US voters will head to the polls on Tuesday to decide whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from the Republican Party of President Trump. Economic conditions and rising prices are the main issues for voters.
The market broadly expects Democrats to win a majority of seats in the House, but gaining control of the Senate is seen as a tougher challenge.
The pound rose 0.1% against the dollar to £1 = $1.3406.

PMI data show that UK manufacturing output at the start of the final quarter of 2026 posted its strongest growth in more than two years. However, rapidly rising costs could worry the Bank of England, and markets anticipate a possible rate hike this week.
The dollar gained 0.23% against the yen, reaching ¥157.89 per $1.
In its full quarterly economic outlook report, the Bank of Japan noted that Japan’s real interest rate has recently risen, especially in the long‑term and ultra‑long‑term rate segments.
